page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3c.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 14 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 56.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 13743 GB of HDD capacity. This massive storage volume is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. The use of traditional HDD storage instead of solid-state drives represents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing high-capacity, cost-efficient bulk storage over low-latency random I/O performance.

This hardware profile is optimized for workloads requiring dense local storage capacity without the need for GPU acceleration. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores and high-capacity HDD storage makes this instance appropriate for large-scale data warehousing, log archiving, cold data storage, and distributed file systems where sequential throughput and storage volume density are prioritized over high-speed random transactional database operations.
